title: Admit the Quirk Intent Shaper as a candidate personalization compiler
desired_change: Evaluate and harden a purpose-scoped Skill that compiles intent, Persona Hand, voice, tone, aesthetic, preferences, settings, platform affects, task affordances, authority, and uncertainty into a reversible Personalization Plan.
expected_outcome: Quirk produces task-specific experiences that feel personally aligned without flattening identity, leaking preferences across purposes, hiding uncertainty, or allowing adaptation capability to become memory authority.

risk.rights_or_safety_impact: Bad personalization can leak context, overfit identity, amplify sensitive inference, or silently change future behavior.

hidden_context_dependencies: Preference evidence is distributed across conversations, settings, files, and runtime projections.
Persona and voice conventions are currently richer than their typed runtime contracts.
Platform affects and task affordances are not yet admitted object families.
Implicit feedback can be misread without purpose and causal context.
acceptance_checks: Current explicit instructions always outrank stored or inferred preferences.
Purpose partitions prevent preference leakage across domains.
Personalization-off mode retrieves no saved preference or persona evidence.
Persona selection never grants authority or claims permanent identity.
Platform affects change form without changing semantic decisions.
Generated UI remains outside the candidate schema until separate accessibility, reconstruction, fallback, and human gates are admitted.
Feedback creates an immutable receipt before any adaptation proposal.
Inferred preferences cannot self-promote into settings or Canon.

Every case in evals/intent-shaper/cases.json executes and passes; derive the count from the current cases array and report IDs/count in byte-bound evidence rather than carrying forward historical twenty-case checks.
The admission-supplies source is explicitly synthetic exercise/context only, not implementation proof, human observations, or verified admission receipts.

The .quirk/evidence/2026-10-04-intent-shaper-governance-repair.json evidence reference is pending, not existing proof: parent must generate it after the implementation commit, commit it in a descendant, and finalize whole-diff validation with the pinned ecosystem validator.
Synthetic QIS-012 through QIS-018 exercises remain explicitly synthetic and cannot satisfy actual human trial, manual accessibility, or preference inspection/correction observations.

Current user approvals authorize bounded repairs and marked synthetic exercises; runtime remains blocked until required evidence and exact scope are supplied, or an authorized human records an explicit narrowly scoped waiver and a new admission decision.
